title: The Multi-Block DC Function Class: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications
summary: We present the Multi-Block DC (BDC) class, a rich class of structured nonconvex functions that admit a DC ("difference-of-convex") decomposition across parameter blocks. This multi-block class not only subsumes the usual DC programming, but also turns out to be provably more powerful. Specifically, we demonstrate how standard models (e.g., polynomials and tensor factorization) must have DC decompositions of exponential size, while their BDC formulation is polynomial.
